description:

Execution contract:

Keep coherent phase work and recover approved detours; do not introduce a global task queue or silently preempt active work. tasks.title: Verify migrations, invariants and complete cross-surface scenarios
tasks.description:
Outcome: Standalone compatibility, migration and complete workflow evidence against the new architecture.

Current implementation: Existing suites and old registration counts are useful precedents, not proof of DB migration, source intelligence or installed behavior.

Implementation responsibility:
- Verify lossless/idempotent old/new migration, context/read/start races, task claims, nested returns, parent/dependency consistency and crash/ack/event boundaries.
- Cover multiple projects/worktrees, source-root separation, schema/driver compatibility, backup/HOME restore and remote snapshot conflict policies.
- Test variable-width F/P/T allocation/resolution/order/search/references/dependencies/exports across 999->1000, 9999->10000 and the declared safe-integer limit.
- Exercise dynamic/text-only/mixed-language setup, large changesets, decision applicability, graph/context budgets, Monaco safe conflicts, project titles and external opener mapping.
- Use exact source/package fingerprints, bounded logs and isolated fixtures. This standalone milestone does not wait on an unavailable Heca runtime; T482 owns the combined final integration gate.

Acceptance and evidence:
- Every required standalone scenario has concrete evidence or a named blocker; no fabricated semantic/source provenance.
- dev-a/dev-b partial integration, squash/rebase/revert and current-vs-historical checks remain distinct.
- No real project migration, Git action, editor launch or arbitrary full-gate repetition is hidden in verification.

tasks.title: Validate installed artifacts and publish the operating guide
tasks.description:
Outcome: Fresh installed-artifact and optional Heca closeout with current operating documentation.

Current implementation: Passing workspace tests or an old package report does not prove a newly packed CLI/MCP/Pi/server/editor integration works.

Implementation responsibility:
- Use the canonical bounded final runner at closeout and freshly packed temporary installations for CLI/MCP/Pi/service bootstrap, source assets and core lifecycle.
- Verify descriptor/global-service identity, document/search/guide delivery, old-client errors, migration/restore and no direct client DB access.
- Validate locally shipped Monaco workers/assets, shared compatible providers, safe saves, titles and fake external openers from installed packages.
- Close optional Heca scope against a supported native host/public API with scoped snapshot/events/chat/actions, permission/epoch/gap/retry cases; label mocked versus real-native evidence.
- Reconcile docs, feature/phase/task limitations and measured context budgets. Preserve completed historical evidence and the AgentTest evidence seam, without adding an autonomous test product or publishing a release.

Acceptance and evidence:
- Standalone installed acceptance and combined Heca acceptance are separately identifiable; no missing host capability is simulated.
- Canonical final evidence is reused only for unchanged content fingerprints and has bounded diagnostics.
- No commit/push/PR/release/global installation occurs without its required explicit user authorization.
